import os, sys, json, hashlib, pathlib, time, gc, threading, traceback
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
out=repo/'docs/neural_tube_napari_segmentation_investigation/20260905T211815Z'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for key,sub in [('MPLCONFIGDIR','mpl_cache'),('NUMBA_CACHE_DIR','numba_cache'),('CUDA_CACHE_PATH','cuda_cache')]:
    os.environ[key]=str(out/sub)
os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM']='offscreen'
os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='4'
os.environ['NUMBA_NUM_THREADS']='4'
import numpy as np, tifffile
def plain(v):
    if isinstance(v, pathlib.Path): return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, np.ndarray): return v.tolist()
    if isinstance(v, np.generic): return v.item()
    raise TypeError(type(v).__name__)
def save(name, data):
    with (out/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(data,f,indent=2,default=plain,allow_nan=False)
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with pathlib.Path(p).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def large_stack(fn):
    result=[]; errors=[]
    def run():
        try: result.append(fn())
        except BaseException: errors.append(sys.exc_info())
    old=threading.stack_size(64*1024*1024)
    t=threading.Thread(target=run); t.start(); t.join()
    threading.stack_size(old)
    if errors: raise errors[0][1].with_traceback(errors[0][2])
    return result[0]
release=repo/'DARE3dv2_Zenodo_040926'
data=repo/'DARE3d_data_190326/Neural_tube_160226'
legacy=data/'weights/segmentation3d_new_set_og/runs/12-01-26'
cfgdir=release/'Neural_tube_160226/weights/segmentation3d_new_set_og/runs/12-01-26'
ckpt=release/'DARE3D_neural_tube_segmentation_epoch057.ckpt'
movies={'movie_I2':(data/'trainingset/movie2/im/movie_I2.tif',data/'trainingset/movie2/label/movie_I2.tif'),
        'movie_M':(data/'test_input/im/movie_M.tif',data/'test_input/label/movie_M.tif')}

os.environ['PROJECT_ROOT']=str(repo)
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
OmegaConf.register_new_resolver('eval',eval,replace=True)
from napari_dare3d import _api as api
from dare3d.metrics import object_level as obj
from unittest.mock import patch
cfg=api._load_inference_cfg(str(cfgdir),str(movies['movie_M'][0].parent),'cpu',checkpoint_path=str(ckpt))
cfg.data.test_data.load_labels=True
cfg.data.test_data.label_folder=str(movies['movie_M'][1].parent)
ds=large_stack(lambda:api._build_dataset(cfg,'segmentation'))
large_stack(ds.make_masks)
truth=ds.movies_masks[0].copy(); truth[:2]=0
annotation_centers=np.array([(t,*np.mean(pair,axis=0)) for t,pairs in enumerate(ds.movies_bipoints[0]) if t>=2 for pair in pairs],dtype=float)
np.save(out/'movie_M_truth_raw.npy',truth)
np.save(out/'movie_M_annotation_centers.npy',annotation_centers)
save('movie_M_truth_inventory.json',{'raw_bipoints_per_frame':[len(v) for v in ds.movies_bipoints[0]],'eligible_annotations':len(annotation_centers),'raw_shape':ds.movies_im[0].shape,'time_padding':ds.time_axis_padding})
del ds,truth; gc.collect()
for movie in movies:
    truth=np.load(out/(movie+'_truth_raw.npy'),mmap_mode='r')
    for profile in ['napari','offline_overlap']:
        name=movie+'_'+profile
        prob=np.swapaxes(tifffile.memmap(out/(name+'.tif')),-1,-3)
        for setting,dilate,threshold,weighted in [('historical',True,.55,.15),('napari_ge',False,.5,.1)]:
            print('BEGIN SCORE',name,setting,flush=True); started=time.perf_counter()
            with patch.object(obj,'dilate_img',obj.dilate_img if dilate else lambda x:x):
                metrics,info=large_stack(lambda:obj.evaluate_at_object_level(prob,truth,threshold,weighted,distance_mode='iou',distance_threshold=1e-6))
            save(name+'_score_'+setting+'.json',{'metrics':metrics,'threshold':threshold,'weighted_cutoff':weighted,'dilation':dilate,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'pred_centers_txyz':info['pred_ccs_stats']['centroids'],'pred_sizes':info['pred_ccs_stats']['voxel_counts'],'pred_mean_probability':info['pred_ccs_stats']['mean_prob'],'true_centers_txyz':info['true_ccs_stats']['centroids'],'matches':info['matched_items']})
            print('DONE SCORE',name,setting,json.dumps(metrics),flush=True)
            del info; gc.collect()
        del prob
